summary: One sprint since the career interview as a conversation (milestone 84). An open interview topic offers Talk live: the candidate speaks, sees their words as they talk, and hears each question in a Chirp 3 HD voice (#2362). Speech streams through Google Cloud in the EU over a WebSocket on the API, and Claude stays the interviewer: each finished turn goes through the same service as a typed answer, so the method-guide check runs before a question is spoken (#2361). Speech ports with scripted fakes (#2359) and the Google adapters (#2360) keep the vendor behind one boundary. Consent must name Google Cloud, which the screen offers to add; a conversation stops at 30 minutes of audio, and logs hold counts only. Off unless DRAFT_LOOP_LIVE_SPEECH=google (#2363). No paid run yet.
knownLimitations: Live speech is off on staging until the bootstrap enables the speech APIs and the environment sets live_speech. A question plays once all its audio has arrived, not as it streams. The interview, typed or live, needs DRAFT_LOOP_SCREENING=rules+model and a Claude key. The local-first desktop has no career interview.
